targets.rawSql: SELECT time, value_temp AS "Temperatur" FROM temperature_values WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND location = 'M1' AND measurement = 'Aussen' AND category <> 'Heizung' AND sensor_type <> 'Heizkörperlüfter' AND measurement <> 'Solltemperatur' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT time::date AS time, max(value_temp) AS "Tages-Maximum" FROM temperature_values WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND location = 'M1' AND measurement = 'Aussen' AND category <> 'Heizung' AND sensor_type <> 'Heizkörperlüfter' AND measurement <> 'Solltemperatur' GROUP BY time::date ORDER BY time

SELECT time::date AS time, min(value_temp) AS "Tages-Minimum" FROM temperature_values WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND location = 'M1' AND measurement = 'Aussen' AND category <> 'Heizung' AND sensor_type <> 'Heizkörperlüfter' AND measurement <> 'Solltemperatur' GROUP BY time::date ORDER BY time

WITH daily_max AS (SELECT time::date AS day, max(value_temp) AS max_value FROM temperature_values WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND location = 'M1' AND measurement = 'Aussen' AND category <> 'Heizung' AND sensor_type <> 'Heizkörperlüfter' AND measurement <> 'Solltemperatur' GROUP BY time::date), avg_max AS (SELECT mean(max_value) AS avg_value FROM daily_max) SELECT day AS time, avg_value AS "Durchschnitt Tages-Höchsttemperatur" FROM daily_max, avg_max ORDER BY day

WITH daily_min AS (SELECT time::date AS day, min(value_temp) AS min_value FROM temperature_values WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND location = 'M1' AND measurement = 'Aussen' AND category <> 'Heizung' AND sensor_type <> 'Heizkörperlüfter' AND measurement <> 'Solltemperatur' GROUP BY time::date), avg_min AS (SELECT mean(min_value) AS avg_value FROM daily_min) SELECT day AS time, avg_value AS "Durchschnitt Tagestiefsttemperatur" FROM daily_min, avg_min ORDER BY day
